132  class Header
   133  {
   134  public:
   135      /**
   136       * This method initializes the MLE header.
   137       *
   138       */
   139      void Init(void)
   140      {
   141          mSecuritySuite   = k154Security;
   142          mSecurityControl = Mac::Frame::kSecEncMic32;
   143      }
   144
   145      /**
   146       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   147       *
   148       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   149       * @retval FALSE  If the TLV does not appear to be well-formed.
   150       *
   151       */
   152      bool IsValid(void) const
   153      {
   154          return (mSecuritySuite == kNoSecurity) ||
   155                 (mSecuritySuite == k154Security &&
   156                  mSecurityControl == (Mac::Frame::kKeyIdMode2 | Mac::Frame::kSecEncMic32));
   157      }
   158
   159      /**
   160       * This method returns the MLE header and Command Type length.
   161       *
   162       * @returns The MLE header and Command Type length.
   163       *
   164       */
   165      uint8_t GetLength(void) const
   166      {
   167          uint8_t rval = sizeof(mSecuritySuite) + sizeof(mCommand);
   168
   169          if (mSecuritySuite == k154Security)
   170          {
   171              rval += sizeof(mSecurityControl) + sizeof(mFrameCounter) + sizeof(mKeySource) + sizeof(mKeyIndex);
   172          }
   173
   174          return rval;
   175      }
   176
   177      enum SecuritySuite
   178      {
   179          k154Security = 0,   ///< IEEE 802.15.4-2006 security.
   180          kNoSecurity  = 255, ///< No security enabled.
   181      };
   182
   183      /**
   184       * This method returns the Security Suite value.
   185       *
   186       * @returns The Security Suite value.
   187       *
   188       */
   189      SecuritySuite GetSecuritySuite(void) const { return static_cast<SecuritySuite>(mSecuritySuite); }
   190
   191      /**
   192       * This method sets the Security Suite value.
   193       *
   194       * @param[in]  aSecuritySuite  The Security Suite value.
   195       *
   196       */
   197      void SetSecuritySuite(SecuritySuite aSecuritySuite) { mSecuritySuite = static_cast<uint8_t>(aSecuritySuite); }
   198
   199      /**
   200       * This method returns the MLE header length (excluding the Command Type).
   201       *
   202       * @returns The MLE header length (excluding the Command Type).
   203       *
   204       */
   205      uint8_t GetHeaderLength(void) const
   206      {
   207          return sizeof(mSecurityControl) + sizeof(mFrameCounter) + sizeof(mKeySource) + sizeof(mKeyIndex);
   208      }
   209
   210      /**
   211       * This method returns a pointer to first byte of the MLE header.
   212       *
   213       * @returns A pointer to the first byte of the MLE header.
   214       *
   215       */
   216      const uint8_t *GetBytes(void) const { return reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(&mSecuritySuite); }
   217
   218      /**
   219       * This method returns the Security Control value.
   220       *
   221       * @returns The Security Control value.
   222       *
   223       */
   224      uint8_t GetSecurityControl(void) const { return mSecurityControl; }
   225
   226      /**
   227       * This method indicates whether or not the Key ID Mode is set to 2.
   228       *
   229       * @retval TRUE   If the Key ID Mode is set to 2.
   230       * @retval FALSE  If the Key ID Mode is not set to 2.
   231       *
   232       */
   233      bool IsKeyIdMode2(void) const { return (mSecurityControl & Mac::Frame::kKeyIdModeMask) == Mac::Frame::kKeyIdMode2; }
   234
   235      /**
   236       * This method sets the Key ID Mode to 2.
   237       *
   238       */
   239      void SetKeyIdMode2(void)
   240      {
   241          mSecurityControl = (mSecurityControl & ~Mac::Frame::kKeyIdModeMask) | Mac::Frame::kKeyIdMode2;
   242      }
   243
   244      /**
   245       * This method returns the Key ID value.
   246       *
   247       * @returns The Key ID value.
   248       *
   249       */
   250      uint32_t GetKeyId(void) const { return Encoding::BigEndian::HostSwap32(mKeySource); }
   251
   252      /**
   253       * This method sets the Key ID value.
   254       *
   255       * @param[in]  aKeySequence  The Key ID value.
   256       *
   257       */
   258      void SetKeyId(uint32_t aKeySequence)
   259      {
   260          mKeySource = Encoding::BigEndian::HostSwap32(aKeySequence);
   261          mKeyIndex  = (aKeySequence & 0x7f) + 1;
   262      }
   263
   264      /**
   265       * This method returns the Frame Counter value.
   266       *
   267       * @returns The Frame Counter value.
   268       *
   269       */
   270      uint32_t GetFrameCounter(void) const { return Encoding::LittleEndian::HostSwap32(mFrameCounter); }
  1110  otError Mle::AppendHeader(Message &aMessage, Header::Command aCommand)
  1111  {
  1112      otError error = OT_ERROR_NONE;
  1113      Header  header;
  1114
  1115      header.Init();
  1116
  1117      if (aCommand == Header::kCommandDiscoveryRequest || aCommand == Header::kCommandDiscoveryResponse)
  1118      {
  1119          header.SetSecuritySuite(Header::kNoSecurity);
  1120      }
  1121      else
  1122      {
  1123          header.SetKeyIdMode2();
  1124      }
  1125
  1126      header.SetCommand(aCommand);
  1127
  1128      SuccessOrExit(error = aMessage.Append(&header, header.GetLength()));
  1129
  1130  exit:
  1131      return error;
  1132  }
